Coram : S.B. SINHA*, MUKUNDAKAM SHARMA
Penal Code, 1860 - s.302 - Prosecution under ss. 302 and 307 - Of two. accused - Charge of co-accused altered to one ulss. 302134 and 307134 in view of supplementary c statement of first informant- Acquittal of both the accused by trial court - High Court convicting the accused u/s. 302 while held: Evidence of eye-witness (first informant) is not reliable - There are vital contradictions in the FIR and the supplementary D statement of the first informant - The contradictions regarding number of injuries, time of occurrence, place of occurrence, sequence of events and the manner
Decision Date : 13-05-2009 | Case No : CRIMINAL APPEAL No. 753/2008 | Disposal Nature : Appeal(s) allowed | Bench : 2 Judges
